description: Rule rates and style profile of research articles in leading journals and their major sub-journals. Built by calibrate.py; statistics only.

method.selection: PDFs: first DOI on pages 1-2 (or in the file name) matched to the journal list in calibrate.py. Saved texts: publisher PDFs converted to text, labelled by hand, kept outside git. Europe PMC: publisher versions of open-access articles, by PMCID. Supplements, author manuscripts and duplicates removed.
method.cleaning: PDFs through pdftotext, JATS XML through its structure; reference lists, back matter, running heads, captions, tables, boxes and citation markers removed; only complete sentences kept.
method.research_article: Has a Methods heading and a Results or Discussion heading; reviews excluded.
method.design: Labelled when the article was selected, otherwise guessed by textstats.detect_design; design groups with fewer than 10 articles are not written.
method.metrics: Per-paper values; quantiles across papers. Rule rates are pooled per 10 000 words.
